title: Philosophiae naturalis principia mathematica, Book III
version: London: 1687; ETH-Bibliothek Zürich Book III section; Public Domain Mark
lineage: Mapped excerpt of the 1687 Latin Book III scan section. The full Book III section was downloaded and hashed; only the mapped pages were retained, and no claim is made that the proof has been independently validated.

passages.note: Book III printed pp. 403–412 / source section PDF pp. 4–13: period and area hypotheses, inverse-square inference, lunar and terrestrial comparison, and the extension to the particles of bodies in Prop. VII.

file.method: Selected pages extracted without changing page content using pdfseparate/pdfunite; corresponding raster renders were compared to the complete source section. Source page numbers count the source PDF from one.
